pages.text: The royal Fort holds weapons and tribute not found in an ordinary camp. Search beyond the obvious path, but expect every useful room to have an owner.$(br2)The Iron Maw is an ancient two-handed cleaver found among royal spoils.

pages.title: The Iron Maw
pages.text: Kills feed its wielder, desperation sharpens it, and the Tyrant enchantment rewards fighting while surrounded. Hover for the complete current tooltip.

pages.title: Hunter's Spear
pages.text: Carried by Ogre Guards. It supports distinct Barbed and Heavy Throw enchantment paths.
